Final preregistration for516's no-crypto padded-tail bound. Root reviewed the lemma, all sources and the inert evaluator; default actual replay passes1,210 exhaustive tiny tail/unpad cases, production-sized cases, low-alphabet/no-supported-length false-bound cases, and boundary statuses. No saved target prefixes have been measured in this proof yet.

Fixed scope is the3,312 legacyRA READY block-primitive ECB/CBC rows identified by the published result and separate strict-port accounting (RC4/Salsa mode aliases excluded). The evaluator pins all original artifacts; P=first544 stored plaintext bytes, Q=P.rstrip(NUL). Each candidate has all possible integer output lengths len(Q)..552/560/576 depending on native block size. A row is marked excluded for this detector only if EVERY possible length is within the published table AND D(Q) exceeds the maximum threshold over that entire interval. Unsupported-length intervals and unresolved bounds remain explicit. The final decrypted block may be arbitrary, with optional trailing-NUL stripping. The first544 bytes are a CONDITION of the model, not a historical KDF/IV assertion.
